verdict.rationale: An authenticator or password-manager app could plausibly offer a natural-language command interface, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such capability: the agent-readable docs (llms.txt, .md mirrors, machine-readable pricing) only let agents read about the product, and the llms.txt itself states 'Public API: None', meaning no agent-callable control surface exists. Operation is through app taps, QR scanning, extension clicks and a keyboard shortcut.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
